request: Build a newsroom analytics dashboard: articles, reads, subscriptions and the editorial task board.
requirements: data source: MySQL database `newsroom_ops`, seeded sample rows, pymysql, .env credentials; metrics: reads, read-through rate, subscriptions, open editorial tasks; charts: line for reads per day, horizontal bars per section, funnel from read to subscribe, and a task list with owner, status and due date; stack: Flask API + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, inline SVG, no CDN; scope: single user, local only; port 5072.
